mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: poster says King main thrust bearings made since 2024 slip onto the cap and block groove too easily rather than being an interference fit, creating a risk of spinning the thrust main, and attributes a free-spread out-of-spec comment to King's own technical line. Serious: safety/warranty implication plus a claimed admission from the brand.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully again: still no King or official reply, thread open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Builder reports King STDX main bearings for BMW S85/S65 with thrust faces over 1mm too narrow to fit the block, says it was confirmed across more than one block, and advises against using King mains on those engines.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Packaging/labelling defect report: a box marked STD is said to have contained 0.25 undersize shells for two cylinders, prompting the poster to tell others to measure every King bearing before installing. Single incident, caught before install.
